build_graph_attention_data: build a GraphAttentionData object from AtomicData using radius graph preprocessing with configurable smearing functions
create_edge_distance_expansion: create edge distance expansion features using Gaussian, Sigmoid, LinearSigmoid, or SiLU smearing functions
generate_radius_graph: generate a kNN radius graph with displacement vectors and neighbor indices from atomic positions
compute_attention_masks: compute attention masks and angle embeddings for graph neural network attention layers
preprocess_atomic_data: preprocess AtomicData into GraphAttentionData with padding, frequency embeddings, and direction expansion
